summary: Require check-slot admission before realizing a cold shared web-check shell, serializing realizations across cache keys.

schema.detail: No application schema changes; shell profiles and compiler state remain disposable.

rules.detail: Ungated prepare refuses missing or broken shell profiles without invoking Nix. Cold check requests admission before shell realization; all cache keys share one realization lock, and Nix uses one local build job with remote builders disabled.

compatibility.detail: Warm preparation and check execution retain their existing behavior. Package scripts and CI workflows are unchanged.

manual.detail: Use python3 scripts/web-check check FILE... for a cold shell. Realization, dependency preparation, and the selected check batch consume the admitted slot's hold time.

recovery.detail: If realization fails, retry check FILE... to obtain admission again. Remove only the affected shared fractal-web-check/v1/shells cache entry to discard a damaged profile, then run check FILE...; prepare never rebuilds it outside admission.
